title: LLMs and self-referentiality
summary: Scott Aaronson discusses the concept of self-referentiality in large language models (LLMs), exploring how models can reason about their own outputs and the implications for AI safety and understanding.
highlights: The post examines the ability of LLMs to engage in self-referential reasoning.
Aaronson connects self-referentiality to broader questions about AI consciousness and reliability.
The discussion includes practical examples and theoretical considerations for AI development.
